# Tales of the Mirror (אגדות המראה)

> Modern fables about emotional defences, the patterns couples fall into, and the road back to yourself

Seven modern fables, each about one way a person can turn love away:
hypersensitivity, fault-finding, loyalty tests, mind-reading, blame,
the threat of separation, and the refusal to forgive. Written in Hebrew
and published in Hebrew, English, Russian, Spanish and Chinese.

## Stories (English)

- [Liryon's Armour of Mirrors](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-1.html): hypersensitivity, low self-worth and the sense of being persecuted
- [Elran's Cloth of Truth](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-2.html): a compulsive focus on what is missing and on flaws
- [Arian's Cedar Roots](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-3.html): the loyalty test and the demand to tear other bonds apart
- [Razia's Waters of Revelation](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-4.html): the illusion of mind-reading, and dressing others in malice
- [Kai's Burden of Stones](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-5.html): the trap of blame, turning a partner into the address for every frustration
- [Noit's Cabin Foundations](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-6.html): using separation and the threat of banishment as a weapon for control
- [Tamara's Bridges of Ash](https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-7.html): demanding perfection, refusing to forgive, and cutting every tie
